page_title: RMA 2-1 GET | Real Madrid v Getafe 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the crossbar.
90+8' The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
90+5' 2 - 1 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom right corner.

90+5' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. David Soria has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
90+5' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe). Mario Melero Lopez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+3' Substitution. Choco Lozano (Getafe) in, Borja Mayoral out.

90+2' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
90+2' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
89' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
87' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Borja Mayoral (Getafe) for a tough tackle.
86' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) prepares to take a corner kick.

86' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
83' Mario Melero Lopez shows the yellow card to Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) for a heavy challenge.
83' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

82' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
81' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
80' Here comes a substitution. Aurelien Tchouameni is given a rest as he is replaced by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid).
80' David Alaba (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but David Soria punches the ball away.
79' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) replaces Damian Suarez.
77' Substitution. Jaime Mata (Getafe) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Juanmi Latasa walks off.
77' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Luka Modric and he is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
76' It's time for a substitution. Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) comes on in place of Daniel Carvajal.
75' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
75' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
74' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
72' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
71' Referee Mario Melero Lopez sees the trip by Djene (Getafe) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
68' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
68' Mario Melero Lopez has issued a yellow card to David Soria (Getafe).

67' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

66' Joselu (Real Madrid) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat David Soria, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
66' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
65' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
64' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kepa Arrizabalaga intercepts the ball.
64' A pass from Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
61' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
59' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
58' Substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) replaces Carles Alena.
58' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

57' Carles Alena (Getafe) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Kepa Arrizabalaga has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
56' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

55' David Soria pulls off a great save to deny Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
54' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the left post.
54' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
51' Today's referee Mario Melero Lopez rightly decides to book Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) for his harsh tackle.
51' Referee Mario Melero Lopez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Real Madrid players celebrate.
49' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Joselu (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
47' Now Real Madrid have a corner.
46' Carlo Ancelotti has made a change at the break. Nacho Fernandez has come on in place of Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
46' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Toni Kroos comes on the pitch for Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
46' The game is over for Omar Alderete (Getafe). Mauro Arambarri comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The foul by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mario Melero Lopez.
45+3' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for an infringement.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.

45' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
44' Joselu (Real Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
42' PENALTY APPEAL after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Madrid was in an offside position.
36' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
33' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

33' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the top left corner, but David Soria is prepared and leaps to thwart him. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
32' A pass into the penalty area from Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
31' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mario Melero Lopez signals.
30' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

29' Joselu (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
28' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
26' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Real Madrid, play can continue.
24' Referee Mario Melero Lopez makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Real Madrid. Let’s see what happens!
24' Carles Alena (Getafe) trips an opposition player and Mario Melero Lopez signals a foul. PENALTY to Real Madrid!
21' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Mario Melero Lopez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
19' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
19' The ball is cleared after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
17' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
15' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
14' Djene (Getafe) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
13' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul.

11' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Borja Mayoral (Getafe) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 0:1.
7' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
5' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
2' Mario Melero Lopez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Luka Modric (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle.
1' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mario Melero Lopez.
